Where the handovers went

About the maker

OOO «Nauchno-proizvodstvennoe obedinenie «Kilovatt»»RussianООО «Научно-производственное объединение «Киловатт»», registered in Lipetsk on 2024-07-2229. It is under sanctions in Ukraine6. Revenue in 2025: ₽1.16bn7.

What this does not show

  • No document records OOO «Nauchno-proizvodstvennoe obedinenie «Kilovatt»» as a formal member of a TsBST programme. Its link to TsBST rests on the posts and statements cited on its card.
  • Fond «Nasha Pravda»'s accounts show it bought «Kapyushon» for transfer to units, but name no seller. Who sold them to it is not documented.
  • The 14 handovers are Fond «Nasha Pravda»'s own reports. None is confirmed by the receiving unit or an independent source, and the post date is not always the handover date.

Every company, listing, contract and handover here comes from an archived document. Listings and handovers are as of the dates shown; 2 listings and 14 handovers are on file.

About and support

This is a solo project by Alexey Kovalev, an independent Russian reporter. I live in exile because I was declared wanted in Russia over my work. I cover Russia's invasion of Ukraine for various outlets and on my own blog.
